status: Bounded 20-entry lexical starter; source forms and transcription key independently reviewed against authorized preview; original pages retained in ignored evidence.

source.author: Sing Sing Ngai
source.title: A Grammar of Shaowu: A Sinitic Language of Northwestern Fujian
source.rights: Copyright retained. Authorized 74-page retail preview obtained normally; only twenty factual lexical readings proposed, not book/table/prose reproduction or full lexicon import.

locality: Urban centre of Shaowu, Fujian, explicitly p.3; not all county townships. Current Shaojiang Min branch node suitable subject to existing catalogue check.
fieldwork: Seven visits from December 2009 to August 2019, p.19. Four consultants: Li Jingxin, female, 91; Li Hougong, male, 82; Gao Ying, female, 68 (ages as of 2020); late Wei Yixin, female, early 70s in December 2009. No item-specific speaker/date assignments.
transcription: Printed LI explicitly specifies IPA; LII explains superscript tone values and distinguishes free variants (~) from tone changes (>). Page 3 supplies six pitch descriptions: 21, 22, 55, 213, 35, 53. Raised h is encoded as Unicode ʰ. Compound syllable spaces and baseline contour digits are display normalization only.
holds: No neutral 0, tone-change variants or circle-plus-subscript uncertain written forms enter this 20-word selection.
Ngai p.4 gives 跤 with 21; the earlier study cited on p.12 has 31. These are not merged.
Standalone 公21 differs from 牛公22; retain the compound’s supplied 22.
得 is multifunctional and excluded from context-free meaning practice and distractors. 帮, 拿, 了 and 度 retain source lexical-sense qualifications beside their readings.
The authorized preview ends on printed p.22. No unauthorized full-book copy is used.
No openly licensed local word recordings were obtained. The reported field recordings are not treated as a playable library.

The former museum domain fjswbwg.com returned unrelated Android-game content on review; it is excluded. Culture uses the separately hosted primary architectural study and the indexed museum catalogue profile.

geography.title: GeoNames · Shaowu · 1795857
geography.locator: Feature P.PPLA3, seat of a third-order administrative division; Fujian, Nanping. Public city-seat anchor, not a consultant home or language boundary. GeoNames CC BY 4.0.

classification: Ngai 2021 pp.12 and 22 explicitly describes the Language Atlas of China Shaojiang classification; p.3 restricts the language reference to urban Shaowu. Competing classifications are discussed in pp.12–18. Website Min/Shaojiang placement follows that Atlas convention; shaowu-localities is explicitly geographic, not a claimed formal subdivision.

review.scope: Root visually checked 20 selected forms on pp.4, 5, 9, 10, 11 and conventions/scope/fieldwork on LI–LII, 3, 19, 22. No candidate corrections requested. Retained page images in ignored evidence.
review.normalization: sourceForm represents source typography with Unicode superscript digits and aspiration ʰ; compound syllables run together as printed. ipa adds syllable spaces and baseline tone digits, without deriving contours.
